I. THE PROPOSED HIGHWAY IMPROVEMENT
Purpose
The Wisconsin Division of Highways, acting jointly with the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission proposes to provide a direct freeway connection between existing Interstate Route 94 and the airport terminal facilities at General Mitchell Field. This highway improvement is being developed to improve vehicular ingress and egress to the airport facilities. The median strip of Interstate Route 94 would also be revised from Layton Avenue to the Airport Spur connection with the construction of additional 13-foot wide traffic lanes and concrete median barrier.
Location
This freeway facility would be located in southeastern Milwaukee County, in the City of Milwaukee. It would be a new location within recommended Corridor No. 5 between Ramsey and Grange Avenues. It would extend from Interstate Poute 94, northeasterly to General Mitchell Field for a length of approximately 1.5 miles. See figures 2 and 3.
Cost
The cost of engineering, right of way and construction for the proposed facility is now estimated to be about $14.0 million, with inflationary factors considered. This estimate includes $2.6 million for right of way. It is anticipated that Milwaukee County's share will be $2.2 million with the remaining portion federal/ state monies.
